summary: The two accepted rigidity applications apply exactly to the even and shifted-odd grids, their affine centroid fields glue on the nondegenerate overlap, and together they cover both endpoints and every intervening fiber. The complete-core certificate is admissible: the chosen integer center satisfies the all-halfspaces balance condition, each full-mass metronoid is the corresponding centroid singleton, and affinity makes every barycentric Minkowski sum the same nonempty singleton. The mass and Q calculations are exact.
